---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a feature for the app, plugin SDK, or tooling
labels: enhancement
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, including other apps
(Aniyomi/Mihon/Tachiyomi) if applicable.

**Additional context**
Anything else — mockups, links, etc.

> Note: requests for new *sources* won't be implemented here — woyomi ships
> no sources. Sources are plugins developed in separate community
> repositories using the public plugin SDK.
